name: Review NewEra Runtime and Documentation Changes
description: Nhắc kiểm tra source ownership, resource references và authority boundary khi tài liệu hoặc runtime layer NewEra thay đổi.

then.prompt: Review this NewEra change for canonical source-of-truth consistency, correct separation of steering/skills/agents/hooks, valid resource references, least-authority role boundaries, precise skill metadata, traceability IDs, ROADMAP impact and accidental scope expansion. Check that no framework/tool is hardcoded into the project-neutral kernel and that no hook or agent creates acceptance automatically. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
